item.title: Tim Scott calls Obamas video shared by Trump 'most racist thing I’ve seen out of this White House'
item.description: Sen. Tim Scott (S.C.), the only Black Republican senator, on Friday sharply rebuked President Donald Trump for posting a since-deleted clip depicting former President Barack Obama and former first lady Michelle Obama as apes, saying it’s “the most racist thing” he’s seen from the administration.
